finding: The scanner-RGB H&E and virtual-DAPI peaks show partial nuclear correspondence, consistent with the frozen DAPI/StarDist technical pass. No obvious rectangular tile-edge shadow is visible at contact-sheet scale. Multiple virtual-protein channels share broad tissue patterns after independent display stretching, but the native nuclear-pixel median cross-channel Spearman is 0.310, so the panels alone do not establish channel duplication. Marker-specific expression cannot be validated here without matched measured images or an independent marker-level reference.
publication_decision: Do not present this field as validated protein-specific staining or cell-type prediction based on technical QC alone. Full-resolution shadow review and marker-level validation remain necessary.
